name: yue_speech_benchmark
description: A Cantonese (Yue) speech benchmark for evaluating automatic speech recognition and related speech-to-text systems on Cantonese audio. It measures ASR transcription quality across diverse speakers and acoustic conditions, providing standardized test sets for model comparison. Useful for researchers developing or fine-tuning Cantonese speech models.
reputation: A niche, language-specific benchmark with limited but growing use in Cantonese ASR research.
